credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Salsola tragus, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salsola_tragus . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Salsola tragus. LUNGING mid-roll: a big, airy ball of dried, wiry, branching stems, sun-bleached straw tan, rolling at the foe. An open lattice: the near stems arc over the ball in the light tone (lit top-left, russet on the shaded side), the far stems show through the gaps in the dark slot, and the background shows between them; spine-tipped sprigs bristle from the rim. A cloud of dust trails off behind its foot and seeds scatter behind it (the motion cue). Gesture: it rolls in and bounces once, scattering seeds (the lattice turns anticlockwise toward the foe, hops, lands squashed in a burst of dust, rebounds and settles); the trailing seeds stay fixed. A russet-brown dark slot under a straw-tan mid. Sport: the young plant's green, red-striped colouring.
